## Type of Change

## Platform Constitution Compliance

- [ ] **Free First** — No paid dependencies introduced
- [ ] **Open Source First** — Any new dependencies are open-source (Apache/MIT/BSD)
- [ ] **Self-Hosted First** — No new SaaS dependencies
- [ ] **No Vendor Lock-In** — No vendor-specific coupling
- [ ] **Reuse Before Build** — Checked existing code before implementing new functionality
